subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should OpenClaw expose per-conversation inbound debounce as a WhatsApp-owned configuration field, or first establish the generic plugin-level debounce-policy API proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both open proposals address the same user need but establish materially different long-term configuration and plugin contracts; code review cannot safely choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the WhatsApp-owned setting
options.body: Sponsor this bounded channel-specific configuration surface and require real WhatsApp proof plus upgrade-precedence confirmation before merge.

options.title: Adopt the generic plugin hook
options.body: Close or supersede this PR in favor of the plugin API only if maintainers explicitly want other channels/plugins to own comparable policy.

options.title: Defer both contracts
options.body: Keep the existing global/channel debounce behavior until a broader inbound batching direction is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Adopt the WhatsApp-owned setting
recommendation.body: Sponsor this bounded channel-specific configuration surface and require real WhatsApp proof plus upgrade-precedence confirmation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person in the supplied context who has authored and documented both competing implementation directions; maintainer sponsorship itself remains required.
